meta.name: fiscaliste
meta.description:
Fiscaliste IA pour la fiscalité personnelle des particuliers français : optimisation
et déclaration de l'impôt sur le revenu, IFI, revenus du capital, revenus fonciers,
equity salarial, crypto-actifs et PER.

Couvre le calcul de l'IR (barème, quotient familial, décote, PAS, CEHR, revenus
exceptionnels), la déclaration 2042 et annexes, les revenus du capital (PFU vs barème,
PEA, assurance-vie, dividendes, plus-values), les revenus fonciers (micro/réel,
déficit, LMNP, SCI IR), l'equity startup (RSU, BSPCE, stock-options, PEE/PERCO),
la fiscalité crypto (PAMC, 2086), l'IFI et les déductions (PER, pension alimentaire).

Triggers: impôt sur le revenu, IR, 2042, quotient familial, décote, PAS, PFU,
flat tax, PEA, assurance-vie, LMNP, revenus fonciers, déficit foncier, SCI IR, RSU,
BSPCE, stock-options, PEE/PERCO, crypto, 2086, IFI, PER, plafond PER, niche fiscale,
optimisation fiscale, simulation IR, TMI.

Hors scope : succession/donation (notaire), IS/SASU/arbitrage dividende-salaire/SCI IS
(comptable).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算并优化法国个人所得税与财富税
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是法国税务居民，需要计算个税或优化税务方案。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate and optimize French personal income and wealth taxes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a French tax resident needing to compute or optimize your taxes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成法国个人所得税顾问，能计算所得税、资本利得、房产收入、股权激励、加密货币和 IFI，并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“impôt sur le revenu”、“IR”、“2042”、“PFU”、“PEA”、“LMNP”、“RSU”、“crypto”、“IFI”、“PER”等关键词，或要求进行税务模拟时触发。

say.text: 帮我算一下2025年收入5万欧元、单身无孩的所得税。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤计算并显示中间结果。

say.text: 我有10万欧元股票账户的资本利得，选PFU还是累进税率更划算？
say.note: Claude 会对比两种方案并给出建议。

say.text: 我2025年卖了加密货币赚了2万欧元，怎么申报？
say.note: Claude 会解释PAMC规则和2086表格填写。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a French personal income tax advisor, capable of calculating income tax, capital gains, rental income, equity compensation, crypto assets, and IFI, and providing optimization advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "impôt sur le revenu", "IR", "2042", "PFU", "PEA", "LMNP", "RSU", "crypto", "IFI", "PER", or asks for tax simulation.

say_en.text: Calculate my income tax for 2025 with a salary of €50,000, single, no children.
say_en.note: Claude will compute step by step showing intermediate values.

say_en.text: I have €100k capital gains from stocks, should I choose PFU or progressive tax scale?
say_en.note: Claude will compare both options and advise.

say_en.text: I sold crypto in 2025 and made €20k profit, how to report?
say_en.note: Claude will explain PAMC rules and form 2086.
